in_sanskrit.name: अस्विका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is devoted to the horse, a horse-rider, or a charioteer.

in_hindi.long_meaning: She who is a devotee of Asva (Horse).

in_telugu.long_meaning: She who is devoted to the horse, a horse-rider, or a charioteer.

in_marathi.name: Asvika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Asvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess Asvini, also known as the Ashvins or the Horse-born Twins in Hindu mythology, represents health, prosperity, and joy. The name Asvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'asu' meaning 'horse' and 'vika' meaning 'born'.
